scopeLimits: Desktop teaching fields and desktop critical/source-grid states receive automatic complete glyph/ink/full-stroke/model audits and retained captures. Personal review covers the listed complete targets; it does not claim personal inspection of every desktop critical image.
method: Every selected complete target has full-width/full-height exact RGB coverage through personally viewed original-resolution sheets or exact earlier inspected pixels. No resizing, sampling, perceptual similarity or acceptance by counts. The current-source scientific/native gate passes separately.
